title: Latent plasticity of the human pancreas across development, health, and disease.
technology: sc/snRNA-seq, snATAC-seq, VASA-seq, spatial transcriptomics (Xenium), multiplexed proteomics (CODEX)
reason: Multi-sample, multi-technology single-cell atlas of human pancreas across development and disease. 57 donors, multiple batches and technologies, suitable for cross-dataset integration and batch correction benchmarking.
methods_summary: Integrated sc/snRNA-seq, snATAC-seq, VASA-seq, spatial transcriptomics (Xenium), and multiplexed proteomics (CODEX) from 57 donors across fetal development, adult homeostasis, and type 2 diabetes to generate a single-cell multiomics atlas of the human pancreas.
